from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 1200, 1500
NAVY = (30, 39, 63)
CREAM = (233, 227, 218)
GOLD = (176, 141, 58)
INK = (34, 34, 34)
GRAY = (120, 118, 112)
WHITE = (245, 242, 236)

FD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation2"
def _font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FD}/{name}.ttf", size)

serif_b = lambda s: _font("LiberationSerif-Bold", s)
serif_r = lambda s: _font("LiberationSerif-Regular", s)
serif_i = lambda s: _font("LiberationSerif-Italic", s)
serif_bi = lambda s: _font("LiberationSerif-BoldItalic", s)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), CREAM)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def center(y, text, font, fill, tracking=0):
    if tracking:
        widths = [d.textlength(ch, font=font) for ch in text]
        total = sum(widths) + tracking * (len(text) - 1)
        x = (W - total) / 2
        for ch, w in zip(text, widths):
            d.text((x, y), ch, font=font, fill=fill)
            x += w + tracking
        return
    w = d.textlength(text, font=font)
    d.text(((W - w) / 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

d.rectangle([0, 0, W, 190], fill=NAVY)
center(70, "BISCAYNE BAR ASSOCIATION", serif_b(46), WHITE, tracking=6)
center(130, "Continuing Legal Education Committee", serif_i(28), (200, 190, 165))
